1.w: A Song of the Ascents. Unto You I lift up my eyes, [to] the One sitting in the heavens.

2.w: Behold, as the eyes of servants [are] to the hand of their masters, as the eyes of a maidservant [are] to the hand of her mistress, so [are] our eyes to YHWH our God, until He shows us mercy.

3.w: Have mercy on us, O YHWH, Have mercy on us! For we are filled exceedingly with contempt.

4.w: Exceedingly our soul has been filled with the scorn of those at ease, with the contempt of the prideful ones.
